The Router's severity rating of 2.0 is appropriate; it's a noticeable defect in fine detail but doesn't ruin the overall object recognition. The 'texture_anomaly' in pearls (Severity 1.5) is also valid, as AI often struggles with complex subsurface scattering in nacre.

All testable geometric and material checkpoints passed. The object is clearly a decorative necklace with pearls and gold-tone metal.

Secondary artifact is the slightly unnatural, overly uniform iridescence of the pearls (Router Severity 1.5).
